content.short: Vezgo provides a single API to access and aggregate customers' digital assets, balances, tokens and trades across multiple chains.
content.description: Vezgo helps app developers integrate with cryptocurrency exchanges and wallets. It provides a single API to access and aggregate all of your customers' digital assets—their balances, tokens, and trades history. Vezgo's crypto API enables tracking of entire web3 portfolios in a SOC 2 Type II certified, compliant manner. Together, these capabilities cover assets, balances, tokens and trades history across web3 portfolios.
content.meta: Vezgo is the fastest way to connect digital assets and web3 accounts to your apps. Discover Vezgo and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Open Finance vs. Open Banking: What's the Real Difference?
resources.tldr: Open banking covers accounts and payments; open finance reaches investments, pensions and crypto. The regulatory backing behind each differs sharply, which decides what you can build on.

resources.title: FiDA, MiCA, and the Future of EU Crypto Data Sharing
resources.tldr: Two EU regimes arriving at once, one about markets and one about data access. Explains how they interlock and what had to be in place before the July 2026 MiCA deadline.

resources.title: Open Finance Stack: Bank, Investment, and Crypto Data
resources.tldr: Connecting a bank, a broker and a wallet means three auth models and three data shapes. Walks the APIs, consent flows and normalisation layer that make them one view.
